resources.string: A backup is one complete copy of everything Clear All Data erases: visits, location points, outings, saved places, photo matches and manual country stays. Export filters and field choices never trim it.
Restore it later with Import history file in Archive, on this phone or on an iPhone. Records that are already there are skipped.
Large journals are split into numbered files. Keep every file together; a restore needs all of them.
Photo matches keep references to the original photos, not the image files.
Backups need an active Whereday plan: Weekly, Yearly or Lifetime. Restoring a backup is free.
Share or save the backup first. Then continue to erase the journal on this phone.
To restore a Whereday backup, choose all of its files together.
Can\'t be used on Android, skipped: %1$s
Existing record IDs are skipped. Nothing on this phone is replaced. Only photo matches made on Android can be restored; image files are not part of the backup.
Your restored records are available in Whereday. Photo matches need access to the original photos.
This backup file is damaged or incomplete. Nothing was restored.
This backup version is not supported. Update Whereday before restoring it.
The backup contains duplicate record identifiers. Nothing was restored.
The backup contains invalid records. Nothing was restored.
Select all files from the same backup. Nothing was restored.
Select one import file, or all files from the same backup.
Each backup file must be smaller than 50 MB. Nothing was restored.
A backup file contains more than 250,000 records. Nothing was restored.
Local storage is full or unavailable. Nothing was restored.
The backup could not be read. Choose its files again. Nothing was restored.
Whereday is clearing its journal. Try the restore again afterwards. Nothing was restored.
